description: This file contains the definition of the class Smarty_Internal_Templateparser, which is responsible for parsing Smarty templates, including handling tokens, rules, and parse trees. It references external classes like Smarty_Internal_Templatelexer and Smarty_Internal_ParseTree, indicating it's part of the Smarty templating engine source code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Templateparser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing Smarty template strings into parse trees, managing tokens, rules, and the overall structure of the template rendering logic.

classes.name: TP_yyStackEntry
classes.description: A class representing a stack entry in the parser's internal stack, holding state information such as the state number, major token, and minor token value.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main parsing method to process a Smarty template according to the defined grammar rules and generate a parse tree.
